findings.claim: Manifest validation accepts null for optional object fields that the schema requires to be objects, so invalid manifests pass validation and are silently treated as absent configuration.
findings.evidence: The runtime checks optional objects with truthiness (`if (r.modelPolicy)`, `if (r.native)`, `if (t.modelPolicy)`, `if (t.skillPolicies)`, `if (t.native)`) in `validateTeam`, so `null` skips validation; the added `skills/process/agent-team-creator/schemas/team.schema.json` defines `modelPolicy` as `#/$defs/policy` object, `skillPolicies` as an object, `native` as an object, and role `native` as an object.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate optional object fields with `!== undefined` and reject null via the existing `object(...)`/`policy(...)` helpers, e.g. `if (r.modelPolicy !== undefined) policy(r.modelPolicy, ...)` and `if (r.native !== undefined) for (...) Object.entries(object(r.native, ...))`.
